verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing API platform, and it documents configurable rules such as 3DS challenge thresholds and merchant blocking, so versioning and rolling back those automations is a fair axis. The evidence shows no way to version, review, or roll back such rules or automations. URL-versioned API endpoints and a Stage environment are adjacent features, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
